drafts.body:
NO TEXTURE SYNTHESIS: FOUR SURFACES, GRADED NOT SCANNED

There is no texture synthesis anywhere in our pipeline. Four real surface families, graded into the palette by code that admits what it did.

Kit surfaces are graded, not scanned: gradeKit() re-maps authored material colours; gradeNature() lerps nature tones into the nine-family contract.

The one scanned plate in the set was lifted legally and graded on top — the licence cleanup sits in the same commit as the grade.

The night pass keeps it honest: emissive veins and lamp pools hold the audited palette under a ringed-planet skybox.

Two world renders travel with this post: Frostline's defence line and Verdant's overview, straight from the world docs.

Procedural-looking does not mean procedural. Ours is authored, graded, and receipted.

ENGINE-SWAP SEASON: LOYALTY IS A COST LINE

RimWorld left Unity for an in-house engine and got 2-4x. Turing Complete left Godot after a years-long rewrite. GameMaker goes free-commercial in 2027.

RimWorld 1.7 (12 Oct 2026): Unity to in-house Waylith engine, same look, 2-4x performance in studio tests.

Turing Complete 2.0 swapped Godot for a custom engine and compiler — a rewrite that took years.

GameMaker's GMRT runtime goes free for commercial use in Jan 2027.

We stay on our engine for audited reasons — web export, payload size, test count — and we re-run that audit every quarter. Loyalty with receipts.

Source capture attached; the article lives at its own URL — we quote numbers, we do not chase clicks.

LEDGER: nothing beyond what we quoted; their benchmarks are theirs, ours are ours, and ours are attached.

EVIDENCE, NOT NOISE: THE TO-DO LIST IS NOT CONTENT

'Shipped dark mode' is a to-do list wearing a megaphone. Build-in-public dies exactly there.

The field's failure mode: daily updates nobody outside the team can use — broadcasting, not building in public.

The working mode: decisions with reasons, screenshots with numbers, failures with dates.

House rule: every post carries a number, a frame, or a confession. Zero of three means it does not post.

One plate travels with this post: signal over noise, in the house palette.

Content is the audit trail of decisions. Everything else is status.

LEDGER: the engagement delta itself stays a measurement, not a promise — we publish the list either way.

The data says confessing beats celebrating by 3-5x. That is exactly why the ledger cannot be a growth hack.

Build-in-public measurements put failure posts 3-5x above milestone posts.

The trap: audiences of supporters cheer confessions and never buy — overlap between readers and buyers is the real metric.

Our ledger line ships in the same font as the wins, on good weeks and bad ones.
